body_text: Skip to Main Content Log in Quiz progress 1 of 8 Help us match you to the right therapist It's important to have a therapist who you can establish a personal connection with. The following questions are designed to match you to a licensed therapist based on your therapy needs and personal preferences. What type of therapy are you looking for? Individual (for myself) Couples (for myself and my partner) Teen (for my child) Let's walk through the process of finding the best therapist for you! We'll start off with some basic questions. The role of AI in identifying a therapist We strive to connect you with a therapist who aligns with your needs and preferences. To make this process as smooth as possible, we use automated tools, including...
